The zero parent has a directly certified orbit. The full absorption law and the complete slice estimate have no Lean proof in this packet.

The all-prepeak 486/F^2 upper bound in ordinary progressions uses its source-specific gate and precision, a simple-orbit physical correction, and an explicit depth horizon. The upper bound does not concern all-surplus ordinary queries. The corresponding ordinary lower bound is a separate fixed-grade offset-moment argument.
